correctness.rationale: The centroid identity gives XY^2+YZ^2+ZX^2=3(MX^2+MY^2+MZ^2). Orthogonal projection splits each term exactly, and the signed-distance function F(P) has the Lemoine point as its quadratic minimizer because the weighted normal equilibrium cancels the cross term. This yields the displayed two-square decomposition and forces equality exactly at the Lemoine pedal triangle. Independent coordinate replays on nondegenerate scalene/right/obtuse examples agreed with the identity.
risks: The identity uses consistently oriented side normals; simultaneous sign reversal is harmless.
